headline: CellAudit finds that predictive accuracy can mask unused intervention inputs
summary: A September 2026 preprint introduces CellAudit, a workflow that checks whether claimed model inputs are implemented in source code, affect fitted predictions, and improve prediction of observed responses. On BBBC047, the authors report an agent-selected model with held-out Global PCC 0.3153 that was invariant to compound replacement; a control-profile-only predictor scored 0.3142. Across 48 generated candidates, 47 changed under compound replacement, but only 20 showed positive target-loss gains on both held-out folds. Revisions recovered positive mean compound contributions. On an independently acquired cohort, dose-use evidence persisted while support for compound identity did not. These are detailed author-reported analyses, not an independent reproduction or proof of biological causality.
